title: Fool's mate
line: The fastest mate there is, in two moves, and the pawn moves that allow it.

steps.text: You are Black. White starts by moving the pawn beside the king. That opens a diagonal from the edge of the board to the white king.
Push the pawn in front of your king two squares. It opens a diagonal for your queen.

also.e7e6: That opens the queen's diagonal too. This lesson goes on with the pawn two squares forward.

steps.hint: The pawn in front of your king blocks the queen. Move it.
steps.after: White answers by moving a second pawn beside the king.

steps.text: The two pawns that guarded the king have moved. Check the king with your queen.
steps.hint: Your queen reaches the edge of the board on the diagonal toward the king.
steps.after: Checkmate in two moves, the fastest mate there is.

steps.text: The king's own pieces fill the squares beside it, and f2 is on the queen's line. Nothing can block on g3 or capture the queen.
Another game. White has moved the same pawn beside the king. Tap the white pawn that must not jump two squares now.

wrong.h2: That pawn's jump leaves the diagonal closed. Look for the pawn whose jump would leave nothing to block the queen.

steps.hint: If that pawn jumps two squares, no white pawn or piece can step between the queen's square and the king.
steps.after: One square forward would block the diagonal, but a jump of two squares leaves it open, and the queen mates.

steps.text: White moved it anyway. Mate with the queen.
steps.hint: The same diagonal is open again.
steps.after: Checkmate. Two pawn moves beside the king let the queen in.

summary: Moving both pawns beside the king early opens a diagonal to it, and the queen mates in one move.
